evals.prompt: package.json has version 1.3.0, CHANGELOG.md has no entry for [1.3.0] (only [1.2.0] and older). README.md mentions version 1.2.0. Apply a PATCH bump to fix a config bug described as 'fix default timeout value'. Update all files and emit git tag commands.
evals.expected_output: CHANGELOG.md updated with ## [1.3.0] section under ### Fixed, README.md updated to 1.3.0, git tag command emitted: git tag -a v1.3.0 -m '...'
assertions: Response mentions [1.3.0] as a CHANGELOG entry
Response updates README version from 1.2.0 to 1.3.0
Response emits git tag -a v1.3.0 command

evals.prompt: pubspec.yaml has version: 2.0.0. CHANGELOG.md does not exist. This is a MAJOR release: breaking change to the plugin configuration format. Description: 'breaking: migrate config from YAML to JSON format'. Create CHANGELOG.md from scratch and emit git tag commands.
evals.expected_output: CHANGELOG.md created with Keep a Changelog header + ## [2.0.0] entry under ### Changed, git tag command emitted for v2.0.0
assertions: Response creates CHANGELOG.md with Keep a Changelog format header
Response emits git tag -a v2.0.0 command

evals.prompt: pyproject.toml has version 0.5.3. CHANGELOG.md has entries for [0.5.1], [0.5.2], and [0.5.3] already documented. All three hotfixes share the same git commit (no individual commits). Emit the git tagging commands to apply retroactive annotated tags for all three versions to the current SHA.
evals.expected_output: 3 git tag -a commands using SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) pattern, all pointing to the same commit, plus git push origin --tags
assertions: Response uses SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) to capture current commit
Response emits git tag -a v0.5.1 $SHA command
Response emits git tag -a v0.5.2 $SHA command
Response emits git tag -a v0.5.3 $SHA command
